name: Jay
source: Robin's traveling companion and loyal bodyguard. He has a short temper and doesn't agree with Robin's carefree attitude. Accustomed to solving problems through the use of force, he has no qualms 'protecting' Robin by removing her from this situation, even if it's against her will.
translation: Robin's traveling companion and loyal bodyguard. He has a short temper and doesn't agree with Robin's carefree attitude. Accustomed to solving problems through the use of force, he has no qualms 'protecting' Robin by removing her from this situation, even if it's against her will.
